{"id":2050989354,"question_id":6,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 weeks, 2 days","timestamp":1782809348,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"5 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2050989354/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Zigzag Conversion","memory":"14.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string convert(string s, int numRows) {\n        string ans = \"\";\n        vector<string>rows(numRows);\n\n        if(numRows == 1) return s; \n        int cyclelength = numRows + (numRows - 2);\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<s.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            int index = i % cyclelength;\n            if(index >= numRows) index = cyclelength - index;\n\n            rows[index] += s[i];\n        }\n\n        for(auto it : rows) ans += it;\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"zigzag-conversion","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2272}
